<P STYLE="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0.25in 0 4pt; text-align: justify"><U>EXHIBIT
10.3: MATERIAL CONTRACTS</U></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify">&thinsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 8pt 0 4pt; text-align: left">Acquisition
of Goldfield Equipment and Inventory (03-26-2024)</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify">&thinsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify">&thinsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify">&thinsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify">TO:&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;Alex Harmon&#9;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">&thinsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify">FROM:&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;James Burgauer, President<BR>
&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;MineralRite
Corporation</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify">&thinsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify">RE:&#9;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;AMENDMENT TO LETTER OF INTENT</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify">&thinsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 12pt; text-align: justify">DATE:&#9;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;&hairsp;March 26, 2024&#9;</P>


<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin-right: 0; margin-bottom: 0; margin-left: 0">&thinsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin-right: 0; margin-bottom: 0; margin-left: 0">This agreement
hereby amends the Letter of Commitment executed by the Parties, as defined therein and as referenced below, on or around February 22,
2024; and shall be known as the Amendment to the Letter of Commitment.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin-right: 0; margin-bottom: 0; margin-left: 0.4in">1. Pursuant
to the terms of paragraph 7 of the Letter of Commitment, MineralRite Corporation (&quot;RITE&quot;) wishes to purchase, and OWNERS wish
to sell, all remaining equipment, inventory, spare parts, tools and other physical components used by or used in the former business of
Goldfield International, Inc.(&quot;EQUIPMENT&quot;), wherever said EQUIPMENT may presently be in use, in storage, in transit or otherwise
located, anywhere in the world, including but not limited to the two known trailer locations in Utah and a on-site in the Democratic Republic
of the Congo .</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 12pt 0pt 12pt 0.4in; text-align: justify">2. RITE
and OWNERS (&quot;PARTIES&quot;) have agreed to consummate this purchase and sale as follows:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin-right: 0; margin-bottom: 0; margin-left: 0.8in">Alex Harmon,
on behalf of OWNERS, will re-assert control over the two trailers of equipment, and assemble an itemized list of the equipment contained
therein and elsewhere; assign a realistic sale value for each item listed thereon; and determine, in his sole discretion, if he believes
each such item should be kept or sold based on its usefulness to the project contemplated herein; and endeavor to sell all such items
that he has determined should be sold. The proceeds for all such items sold will be promptly deposited, directly or transmitted by Zelle
or other means, to the financial account of RITE and will be accounted for accordingly.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin-right: 0; margin-bottom: 0; margin-left: 0.8in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin-right: 0; margin-bottom: 0; margin-left: 0.8in">Based
on the preliminary analysis estimate of the PARTIES, and subject to adjustment, such adjustment to be completed with 30 days of the execution
of this formal Amendment to Letter of Commitment, RITE will issue to OWNERS the collective sum of 300 shares of RITE Preferred Series
C, each share of which is convertible into 400,000 shares of RITE common stock, to be registered in the individual names of OWNERS pursuant
to instructions provided to RITE by OWNERS under the original Letter of Commitment.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin-right: 0; margin-bottom: 0; margin-left: 0.8in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin-right: 0; margin-bottom: 0; margin-left: 0.8in">For the
personal services of Alex Harmon (&quot;OWNER CONSULTANT&quot;) being performed hereunder, RITE will reimburse OWNER CONSULTANT for all
out-of-pocket expenses paid by OWNER CONSULTANT and issue an amount of no less than 50 shares of RITE Preferred Series C, each share of
which is convertible into 400,000 shares of RITE common stock as shall be mutually determined and agreeable to the RITE and OWNER CONSULTANT.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin-right: 0; margin-bottom: 0; margin-left: 0.4in">3. The
Parties hereto also agree to execute and supply all documentation required to evidence this agreement and their performance of duties
required under this agreement as may be required by any legal, accounting and/or tax professionals, and further agree to replace this
agreement, when and if needed, with a more formal document containing substantively similar terms and conditions as those contained herein
but written in such manner as may be prescribed by said aforementioned legal, accounting and/or tax professionals.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 12pt 0pt 0pt; text-align: justify">It is my hope
that this simple letter of agreement accurately reflects all of the terms and conditions to which we have agreed, and will be adequate
to serve each Party's purpose until such time as a more formal document may be required and assembled.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin-right: 0; margin-bottom: 0; margin-left: 0"><B>&thinsp;</B></P>
